svg.title: Canadian grocery gift cards with cashback
svg.desc: Stacked bars comparing paying with a rewards card in store versus buying a grocery gift card through a cashback portal then shopping.
svg.text: When a grocery gift card beats paying at the till
Illustrative $200 Loblaw-family shop. Portal rates change. Confirm exclusions before you pre-fund.

g.text: A. Pay in store with PC World Elite
If the card is accepted and paid in full
B. Portal gift card 2% + no-fee 1% card (if gift cards code)
Only if the card does not exclude GCs
C. Same stack when gift cards earn 0% on the card
Worse than A if you already have PC WE
Trap: many issuers exclude gift cards from bonus categories. Loyalty apps may also skip points on the gift-card purchase itself.
Using the card in store later can still load PC Optimum / Scene+ / Moi offers - verify in-app.

svg.text: Rakuten.ca Gift Card Shop has listed Loblaws and Superstore cards around 2% Cash Back (rate advertised as of public pages reviewed 16 Sep 2026).
